name: Tea stall, Mutanabbi Street
description: A small outdoor tea stall on Mutanabbi Street in Baghdad on a sunny morning: a wooden counter with a plain brass samovar (an ordinary metal object, no face) and rows of small clear tulip-shaped istikan tea glasses on saucers, two low wooden stools, stacks of second-hand books on tables along the old brick arcade behind it, soft warm sunlight.
landmarks: The brass samovar on the right end of the counter; the old brick arcade with book tables behind the stall
